enriched_activities.activity: Late-night creative session: working on personal art project at the computer, using the desk lamp and monitor, sketching and refining digital artwork
enriched_activities.desc: Sit down on the chair at the desk. Press the power button on the computer tower. Press the power button on the monitor. Turn on the desk lamp switch. Open the digital art file. Pick up the stylus pen. Draw line strokes on the tablet. Press the shortcut keys on the keyboard to zoom in. Move the cursor to the layer panel. Click to add a new layer. Adjust the brush size slider. Draw outline strokes on the canvas. Press the undo key combination. Redraw the outline. Click the colour picker tool. Select a colour from the palette. Fill the outlined area. Drag the colour slider. Press keys to save the file. Press keys to save the file again. Scroll the canvas with the mouse wheel. Click the eraser tool. Erase edge marks. Rotate the wrist and adjust the monitor tilt. Type a file name into the save dialog. Press Enter to confirm. Lean back and stretch both arms. Turn off the desk lamp switch. Click the shutdown option. Stand up from the chair. Push the chair back under the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Night wash-up and getting ready for sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Wet both hands under the water. Pick up the facial cleanser bottle. Squeeze cleanser onto the palm. Rub both palms together. Apply the foam to the face. Rinse the face with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel from the hook. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel back on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse the mouth with tap water. Turn off the tap. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping (night owl late bedtime, sleeping in as long as the workday allows)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 2. Switch off the light. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Turn onto the side. Close the eyes. Remain lying on the bed asleep. Turn onto the other side during the night. Pull the blanket up. Remain lying asleep. Turn onto the back. Remain lying asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Shower, dress, and morning grooming (extended slightly to avoid kitchen overlap with Member 3)
enriched_activities.desc: Open the eyes. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the water heater switch. Turn on the shower tap. Step into the shower. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Squeeze shampoo into the palm. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap over the body. Rinse the body. Turn off the shower tap. Step out of the shower. Pick up the towel. Dry the hair with the towel. Dry the body with the towel. Hang the towel on the hook. Turn on the fan switch. Wipe the mirror with the hand. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse the mouth. Pick up the comb. Comb the hair. Open the wardrobe. Take out the work clothes. Put on the shirt. Put on the trousers. Put on the socks. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Quick breakfast prepared and eaten, following a medically restricted diet (after Member 3 clears the kitchen)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the breakfast container. Close the refrigerator door. Place the container on the counter. Open the microwave door. Put the container inside. Close the microwave door. Press the start button on the microwave. Wait standing at the counter. Press the stop button when the timer sounds. Open the microwave door. Take out the container. Close the microwave door. Pick up a fork from the drawer. Eat the breakfast from the container. Pick up the cup. Drink water from the cup. Put the cup down. Carry the container to the sink. Rinse the container under the tap. Turn off the tap. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying personal space, laying out belongings, and gathering work bag and keys
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 2. Pull the blanket up and smooth it over the mattress. Flatten the pillow with both hands. Pick up the clothes from the chair. Fold the clothes. Place the clothes in the wardrobe. Close the wardrobe door. Pick up the work bag from the floor. Open the bag zipper. Put the laptop into the bag. Close the bag zipper. Pick up the keys from the nightstand. Put the keys into the trouser pocket. Pick up the phone from the nightstand. Slide the phone into the pocket. Turn off the bedroom light. Walk out of the bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Unplugging and starting the personal electric vehicle, loading work items
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the garage. Turn on the garage light. Walk to the electric vehicle. Grasp the charging plug. Pull the charging plug out of the vehicle socket. Hang the cable on the wall hook. Close the charging port cover. Open the vehicle door. Place the work bag on the passenger seat. Sit down in the driver's seat. Close the vehicle door. Press the start button. Turn off the garage light.

enriched_activities.activity: drive the EV to the workplace, running behind schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Press the accelerator pedal. Steer the wheel out of the driveway. Turn the wheel to join the main road. Press the brake pedal at the intersection. Press the accelerator pedal again. Glance at the dashboard display. Press the brake at the traffic light. Press the accelerator when the light changes. Merge into the traffic lane. Press the brake approaching the car park. Turn the wheel into the parking space. Press the brake pedal to stop. Press the start button to power off. Open the door. Get out of the vehicle. Open the rear door. Pick up the work bag. Close the rear door. Lock the vehicle with the key fob.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the office in retail management and healthcare administration, handling scheduling, staff and patient administration tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the office. Sit down at the desk. Press the power button on the computer. Log in with the password on the keyboard. Open the scheduling software. Click on the staff roster tab. Type shift entries into the roster. Drag shift blocks to reassign staff. Click the save button. Open the patient administration file. Read the patient record on the screen. Type notes into the record field. Answer the ringing desk phone. Hold the handset to the ear and say 'Good morning, how can I help you?'. Write the caller's request on a notepad with a pen. Put the handset back on the cradle. Stand up and walk to the filing cabinet. Pull open the top drawer. Take out a folder. Close the drawer. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Open the folder. Compare the paper form with the screen record. Type the missing data into the computer. Pick up a form from the printer tray. Sign the form with a pen. Place the form in the out-tray. Pick up the mug. Take a drink. Put the mug down. Click through the inventory report on the screen.

enriched_activities.activity: Lunch break at work, eating a meal that meets a medically restricted diet
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the desk. Pick up the lunch container from the work bag. Walk to the break room. Open the refrigerator door. Place the container inside for a moment. Take the container back out. Close the refrigerator door. Open the microwave door. Put the container inside. Close the microwave door. Press the start button. Wait standing beside the microwave. Press the stop button when the timer sounds. Open the microwave door. Take out the container. Close the microwave door. Sit down at the break room table. Open the container lid. Pick up the fork. Eat the meal from the container. Put the fork down. Pick up the water bottle. Unscrew the cap. Drink water. Screw the cap back on. Pick up a napkin. Wipe the mouth with the napkin. Close the container lid. Stand up. Carry the container to the sink. Rinse the container under the tap. Turn off the tap. Walk back to the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing administrative and retail management duties, meetings, and record-keeping at the workplace
enriched_activities.desc: Sit down at the desk. Click open the email inbox. Read the messages on the screen. Type replies on the keyboard. Press the send button. Pick up the notepad. Write meeting notes with a pen. Stand up. Carry the notepad to the meeting room. Sit down at the meeting table. Open the laptop. Click through the presentation slides. Point at the screen and say 'This is the updated staffing plan.'. Write additional notes on the notepad. Nod at the colleague across the table. Close the laptop. Stand up. Walk back to the desk. Sit down. Open the record-keeping spreadsheet. Type figures into the cells. Press keys to save the file. Open the retail stock report. Check the stock numbers against the printed list. Mark numbers with a pen on the printout. Pick up the desk phone handset. Dial the supplier extension. Say 'We need the delivery moved to Thursday.'. Put the handset back on the cradle. Write the change on the notepad. Stand up. Walk to the printer. Pick up the printed pages. Staple the pages with the stapler. Walk back to the desk. Place the pages in the folder. Close the folder. Click the shutdown option on the computer. Stand up. Pick up the work bag.

enriched_activities.activity: drive the EV back home
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the parked electric vehicle. Press the unlock button on the key fob. Open the driver's door. Place the work bag on the passenger seat. Sit down in the driver's seat. Close the door. Fasten the seat belt. Press the start button. Press the accelerator pedal. Steer out of the parking space. Turn the wheel onto the road. Press the brake at the first intersection. Press the accelerator when the road clears. Press the brake at the traffic light. Press the accelerator when the light changes. Drive along the main road. Turn the wheel into the neighbourhood street. Press the brake approaching the house. Turn the wheel into the driveway. Press the brake pedal to stop. Press the start button to power off. Unfasten the seat belt. Open the door. Get out of the vehicle. Open the rear door. Pick up the work bag. Close the rear door.

enriched_activities.activity: Parking and plugging in the EV, unloading work items
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on the garage light. Walk to the wall charging point. Pick up the charging cable. Open the charging port cover on the vehicle. Push the charging plug into the vehicle socket. Check that the plug is seated. Walk to the rear of the vehicle. Open the rear door. Pick up the work bag and any remaining items. Close the rear door. Turn off the garage light. Walk towards the house.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with Member 1, using induction cooker and rice cooker, preparing a meal compatible with everyone's dietary needs
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Put the work bag on the counter. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables and the protein container. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Wash the vegetables under the tap. Turn off the tap. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables on the cutting board. Push the cut vegetables into a bowl. Open the rice cooker lid. Measure rice into the inner pot with the cup. Pour water into the pot. Close the rice cooker lid. Press the cook button on the rice cooker. Turn on the induction cooker. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Add the vegetables to the pan. Pick up the spatula. Stir the vegetables in the pan. Say to Member 1 'The rice cooker is already on.'. Add the protein to the pan. Stir again with the spatula. Press the range hood button. Turn off the induction cooker. Pick up plates from the cupboard. Spoon the dishes onto the plates. Carry the plates to the dining room.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner with Member 1 and Member 3 at the table, air conditioner on, phone face-down for a calm meal
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on the air conditioner with the remote. Place the phone face-down on the dining table. Pull out the chair. Sit down at the table with Member 1 and Member 3. Pick up the chopsticks. Take food from the shared dishes. Eat the rice from the bowl. Put the chopsticks down. Pick up the cup. Drink water. Put the cup down. Pick up the chopsticks again. Take more vegetables. Say to Member 1 'The rice turned out well tonight.'. Turn to Member 3 and say 'How was school today?'. Chew and swallow the food. Put the chopsticks down. Pick up the bowl. Finish the rice. Put the bowl down. Pick up a napkin. Wipe the mouth with the napkin. Stand up. Pick up the plates and bowls. Carry them to the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes with Member 1 and Member 3, wiping counters, packing tomorrow's lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Place the plates and bowls beside the sink. Turn on the tap. Pick up the sponge. Add dish soap to the sponge. Scrub the plates under the running water. Rinse the plates. Place the plates in the drying rack. Scrub the bowls. Rinse the bowls. Place the bowls in the drying rack. Scrub the chopsticks. Rinse the chopsticks. Place the chopsticks in the drying rack. Turn off the tap. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the counter surface. Wipe the cutting board. Rinse the cloth. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the lunch container. Close the refrigerator door. Spoon the leftovers into the lunch container. Close the lid. Place the container in the refrigerator. Close the refrigerator door. Pick up the cloth again. Wipe the dining table crumbs into the hand. Throw the crumbs into the bin. Turn off the kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening dog walk with Member 1 along the familiar neighbourhood loop, staying on well-lit paths
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the entryway. Pick up the dog leash from the hook. Clip the leash onto the dog's collar. Open the front door. Step outside with Member 1 and the dog. Walk along the footpath. Hold the leash in the left hand. Turn the corner at the end of the street. Keep to the lit side of the road. Slow down as the dog sniffs the grass. Tug the leash gently. Continue walking along the loop. Cross the street at the crossing. Walk past the parked cars. Turn onto the return street. Say to Member 1 'Let's head back before it gets cold.'. Walk up the path to the front door. Unclip the leash from the dog's collar. Open the front door. Step inside. Hang the leash back on the hook. Close the front door.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting with Member 1 and Member 3, sending one-on-one text check-ins and browsing cultural events on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Sit down on the sofa beside Member 1 and Member 3. Pick up the phone from the pocket. Tap the messaging app. Type a text message to a friend. Press the send button. Tap the next conversation. Type a reply. Press the send button. Tap the note icon. Add a note about calling back. Tap the browser app. Type 'art exhibition' into the search bar. Press Enter. Scroll the search results with the thumb. Tap an event page. Read the details on the screen. Tap the save icon. Press the phone lock button. Place the phone on the armrest. Turn to Member 3 and say 'Did you finish your homework?'. Pick up the phone again. Open the messages app. Reply to one more message. Press the phone lock button.

enriched_activities.activity: Running a load of laundry and tidying the house
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the laundry room. Turn on the laundry light. Open the washing machine door. Pick up the laundry basket. Sort the clothes into the drum. Close the washing machine door. Open the detergent drawer. Pour detergent into the drawer. Close the detergent drawer. Press the power button on the washing machine. Turn the programme dial. Press the start button. Pick up the vacuum cleaner. Plug the vacuum cord into the socket. Push the vacuum over the floor. Pull the vacuum back towards the doorway. Press the power button off on the vacuum. Unplug the cord. Wind the cord around the hook. Put the vacuum cleaner back in the corner. Turn off the laundry light. Walk out of the laundry room.

enriched_activities.activity: Unwinding on the sofa watching television to decompress after the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the television remote. Press the power button. Press the channel button. Press the volume button. Place the remote on the cushion. Lean back against the sofa. Watch the television screen. Pick up the remote again. Press the volume down button. Put the remote down. Cross the legs on the sofa. Watch the programme. Sit up and reach for the glass on the side table. Pick up the glass. Drink water. Put the glass down. Lean back again. Pick up the remote. Press the power button to switch the television off. Stand up from the sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Focused artistic work at the computer, developing creative and cultural projects with the monitor and desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the study. Sit down at the desk. Press the power button on the computer. Press the power button on the monitor. Turn on the desk lamp switch. Open the project folder. Double-click the artwork file. Pick up the stylus pen. Draw new strokes on the tablet. Press the keyboard shortcut to open the colour palette. Click a colour swatch. Fill the selected area. Press the shortcut to add a layer. Draw additional details on the canvas. Press the undo keys. Redraw the detail. Drag the layer order in the panel. Click the text tool. Type a caption onto the canvas. Press keys to save the file. Press the export option. Select the file format. Press Enter to export. Scroll through the exported preview. Click the shutdown option. Turn off the desk lamp switch. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk. Walk out of the study.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening hygiene routine, washing up and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Wet both hands under the water. Pick up the facial cleanser bottle. Squeeze cleanser onto the palm. Rub both palms together. Apply the foam to the face. Rinse the face with water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face with the towel. Hang the towel on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse the mouth with tap water. Turn off the tap. Pick up the floss. Floss between the teeth. Throw the floss into the bin. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Wind-down reading in bed under the desk lamp, aiming for an earlier night
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 2. Turn on the bedroom light. Pick up the book from the nightstand. Sit down on the bed. Turn on the desk lamp. Open the book to the bookmark. Lie back on the pillow. Read the page. Turn the page. Read the next page. Place the bookmark between the pages. Close the book. Put the book on the nightstand. Turn off the desk lamp. Turn off the bedroom light. Lie down flat on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on the bed with eyes closed. Turn onto the side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Remain lying asleep. Turn onto the back. Remain lying asleep.
